content.text: {"title":"Softmax over the scores","narration":"Here are the scaled scores from last time, one row per token. Raw scores are not weights, so we apply a [[soft]]softmax to each row. Softmax raises e to every score, then divides by the row total, so each row is positive and adds up to one. Take the first row: zero point five, one, and zero become about [[r0]]zero point three one, zero point five one, and zero point one nine. The second row gives [[r1]]nearly the same shape, and the third row gives [[r2]]more weight to the last token. Read the grid as which word attends to which. The [[peak]]strongest weight is zero point five five, where the third token attends to itself. Now look at the curve. Hold two other scores at zero and slide one score up. The [[curve]]weight rises in an S shape, slowly at first, then quickly, then flattening toward one. At a score of [[pt]]one, the weight is about zero point five eight.
